# VO2 Max & Cardio Fitness

> VO2 Max & Cardio Fitness is a VO2 max app for iPhone and Apple Watch. See your Apple Health VO2 max estimate, cardio fitness trend and fitness age. Private.

## App

- [VO2 Max App for iPhone | VO2 Max & Cardio Fitness](https://jackwallner.com/ios/vo2max/index.html.md): VO2 Max & Cardio Fitness is a VO2 max app for iPhone and Apple Watch. See your Apple Health VO2 max estimate, cardio fitness trend and fitness age. Private.

- [VO2 Max Chart by Age and Sex: Apple Watch Levels](https://jackwallner.com/ios/vo2max/vo2-max-chart-by-age-and-sex.html.md): VO2 max percentiles by age and sex from the FRIEND registry, how Apple Watch cardio fitness levels use them, and how to read your own number. Sourced and plain.
